WITH RECURSIVE grp AS (
  SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE name = 'Helios Grocery'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.group_id FROM dim_merchant_group g JOIN grp ON g.parent_group_id = grp.group_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT substr(t.ts_utc,1,10) AS d
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta
    ON ta.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
   AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from
   AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
  JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id = ta.merchant_id
  WHERE m.group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM grp)
),
dow AS (
  SELECT d,
         CASE CAST(strftime('%w', d) AS INTEGER) WHEN 0 THEN 7 ELSE CAST(strftime('%w', d) AS INTEGER) END AS isodow
  FROM base
),
thu AS (
  SELECT d, date(julianday(d) + 4 - isodow) AS th
  FROM dow
),
wk AS (
  SELECT th, CAST(strftime('%Y', th) AS INTEGER) AS iy FROM thu
),
yinfo AS (
  SELECT iy,
         (CASE CAST(strftime('%w', CAST(iy AS TEXT) || '-01-04') AS INTEGER) WHEN 0 THEN 7 ELSE CAST(strftime('%w', CAST(iy AS TEXT) || '-01-04') AS INTEGER) END) - 1 AS jan4shift
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT iy FROM wk)
)
SELECT wk.iy,
       CAST((julianday(wk.th) - (julianday(CAST(yinfo.iy AS TEXT) || '-01-04') - yinfo.jan4shift)) / 7 AS INTEGER) + 1 AS iso_week,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM wk JOIN yinfo ON yinfo.iy = wk.iy
GROUP BY wk.iy, iso_week
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 8

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn) AS total_txn,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn t JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)) AS matched_any,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn t JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to) JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id WHERE m.group_id IN (10,11,12,13,14)) AS helios

WITH RECURSIVE divtree AS (
  SELECT g.group_id, g.name AS div_name, g.group_id AS div_id
  FROM dim_merchant_group g
  JOIN dim_merchant_group p ON p.group_id = g.parent_group_id
  WHERE p.parent_group_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.group_id, t.div_name, t.div_id
  FROM dim_merchant_group d JOIN divtree t ON d.parent_group_id = t.group_id
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT 1 AS w UNION ALL SELECT w+1 FROM weeks WHERE w < 52
),
base AS (
  SELECT substr(t.ts_utc,1,10) AS d, t.terminal_id, dt.group_id AS div_id, dt.div_name
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta
    ON ta.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
   AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from
   AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
  JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id = ta.merchant_id
  JOIN divtree dt ON dt.group_id = m.group_id
  WHERE t.ts_utc >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts_utc < '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
dow AS (
  SELECT d, terminal_id, div_id, div_name,
         CASE CAST(strftime('%w', d) AS INTEGER) WHEN 0 THEN 7 ELSE CAST(strftime('%w', d) AS INTEGER) END AS isodow
  FROM base
),
thu AS (
  SELECT d, terminal_id, div_id, div_name, date(julianday(d) + 4 - isodow) AS th FROM dow
),
iso AS (
  SELECT th, terminal_id, div_id, div_name,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', th) AS INTEGER) AS iy,
         CAST((julianday(th) - (julianday(CAST(strftime('%Y', th) AS INTEGER) || '-01-04') -
           ((CASE CAST(strftime('%w', CAST(strftime('%Y', th) AS INTEGER) || '-01-04') AS INTEGER) WHEN 0 THEN 7
             ELSE CAST(strftime('%w', CAST(strftime('%Y', th) AS INTEGER) || '-01-04') AS INTEGER) END) - 1)
         )) / 7 AS INTEGER) + 1 AS iw
  FROM thu
),
counts AS (
  SELECT div_id, div_name, iw, COUNT(*) AS y
  FROM iso WHERE iy = 2025 AND iw BETWEEN 1 AND 52
  GROUP BY div_id, div_name, iw
),
filled AS (
  SELECT dv.div_id, dv.div_name, w.w, COALESCE(c.y, 0) AS y
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT div_id, div_name FROM divtree) dv
  CROSS JOIN weeks w
  LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.div_id = dv.div_id AND c.iw = w.w
)
SELECT div_name,
       ROUND((52.0 * SUM(w * y) - 1378.0 * SUM(y)) / 609076.0, 4) AS slope,
       SUM(y) AS total_txns
FROM filled
GROUP BY div_id, div_name
ORDER BY slope DESC

WITH seq AS (
  SELECT txn_id, terminal_id, ts_utc,
         LEAD(ts_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY terminal_id ORDER BY ts_utc, txn_id) AS next_ts
  FROM txn
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS retried,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.ts_utc >= '2025-09-18 00:00:00' AND s.ts_utc < '2025-09-19 00:00:00' AND rcd.is_timeout=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeouts_day,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.ts_utc >= '2025-09-18 00:00:00' AND s.ts_utc < '2025-09-19 00:00:00' AND rcd.is_timeout=1
                 AND s.next_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.next_ts > s.ts_utc AND s.next_ts <= datetime(s.ts_utc, '+90 seconds')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retried_count
FROM seq s
JOIN response_code_dict rcd ON rcd.code = (
  SELECT t.response_code FROM txn t WHERE t.txn_id = s.txn_id
)
WHERE s.ts_utc >= '2025-09-18 00:00:00' AND s.ts_utc < '2025-09-19 00:00:00' AND rcd.is_timeout = 1

WITH seq AS (
  SELECT txn_id, terminal_id, ts_utc, response_code,
         LEAD(ts_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY terminal_id ORDER BY ts_utc, txn_id) AS next_ts
  FROM txn
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_timeouts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN next_ts IS NOT NULL AND next_ts > ts_utc AND next_ts <= datetime(ts_utc, '+90 seconds') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retried
FROM seq s
JOIN response_code_dict rcd ON rcd.code = s.response_code
  AND s.ts_utc >= rcd.valid_from AND (rcd.valid_to IS NULL OR s.ts_utc < rcd.valid_to)
WHERE s.ts_utc >= '2025-09-18 00:00:00' AND s.ts_utc < '2025-09-19 00:00:00'
  AND rcd.is_timeout = 1

WITH calc AS (
  SELECT s.settlement_id, s.settled_at, s.settled_eur_minor,
         ROUND(1.0 * t.amount_minor / (CASE c.exponent WHEN 0 THEN 1.0 WHEN 2 THEN 100.0 WHEN 3 THEN 1000.0 END) * f.eur_per_unit * 100.0) AS recomp
  FROM settlement s
  JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id = s.txn_id
  JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id = t.currency_id
  JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id = t.currency_id AND f.rate_date = date(s.settled_at)
),
dow AS (
  SELECT settled_at, ABS(recomp - settled_eur_minor) AS d,
         CASE CAST(strftime('%w', settled_at) AS INTEGER) WHEN 0 THEN 7 ELSE CAST(strftime('%w', settled_at) AS INTEGER) END AS isodow
  FROM calc
),
thu AS (
  SELECT settled_at, d, date(julianday(settled_at) + 4 - isodow) AS th FROM dow
),
iso AS (
  SELECT settled_at, d,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', th) AS INTEGER) AS iy,
         CAST((julianday(th) - (julianday(CAST(strftime('%Y', th) AS INTEGER) || '-01-04') -
           ((CASE CAST(strftime('%w', CAST(strftime('%Y', th) AS INTEGER) || '-01-04') AS INTEGER) WHEN 0 THEN 7
             ELSE CAST(strftime('%w', CAST(strftime('%Y', th) AS INTEGER) || '-01-04') AS INTEGER) END) - 1)
         )) / 7 AS INTEGER) + 1 AS iw
  FROM thu
)
SELECT iy, iw, ROUND(SUM(d), 2) AS sum_diff, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM iso
GROUP BY iy, iw
ORDER BY sum_diff DESC
LIMIT 8

WITH leaves AS (
  SELECT g.group_id, g.name
  FROM dim_merchant_group g
  WHERE g.group_id NOT IN (SELECT parent_group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id IS NOT NULL)
),
h1 AS (
  SELECT m.merchant_group_id AS gid, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_merchant_link l
    ON l.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
   AND t.ts_utc >= l.start_ts AND (l.end_ts IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < l.end_ts)
  JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id = l.merchant_id
  WHERE t.ts_utc < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
),
h2 AS (
  SELECT m.merchant_group_id AS gid, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_merchant_link l
    ON l.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
   AND t.ts_utc >= l.start_ts AND (l.end_ts IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < l.end_ts)
  JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id = l.merchant_id
  WHERE t.ts_utc >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00' AND t.ts_utc < '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT lv.name,
       COALESCE(h1.n,0) AS h1_n,
       COALESCE(h2.n,0) AS h2_n,
       COALESCE(h1.n,0) - COALESCE(h2.n,0) AS loss
FROM leaves lv
LEFT JOIN h1 ON h1.gid = lv.group_id
LEFT JOIN h2 ON h2.gid = lv.group_id
ORDER BY loss DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH w AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id,
    CAST((julianday(date(substr(t.ts_utc,1,10), '-6 days', 'weekday 1'))
      - julianday(date(strftime('%Y', date(substr(t.ts_utc,1,10), '-3 days', 'weekday 4')) || '-01-04', '-6 days', 'weekday 1')))/7 AS INTEGER) + 1 AS wk,
    strftime('%Y', date(substr(t.ts_utc,1,10), '-3 days', 'weekday 4')) AS iso_yr
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta
    ON t.terminal_id = ta.terminal_id
   AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from
   AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
  JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id = ta.merchant_id
  WHERE m.group_id IN (10,11,12,13,14)
)
SELECT iso_yr, printf('%02d', wk) AS wknum, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM w
GROUP BY iso_yr, wknum
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn t JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON t.terminal_id=ta.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc>=ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<ta.valid_to) JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id WHERE m.group_id IN (10,11,12,13,14)) AS matched,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn t JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON t.terminal_id=ta.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc>=ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<ta.valid_to) JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id WHERE m.group_id IN (10,11,12,13,14))
 +
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn t WHERE t.terminal_id IN (SELECT terminal_id FROM terminal_assignment a JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=a.merchant_id WHERE m.group_id IN (10,11,12,13,14))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM terminal_assignment ta WHERE ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id AND t.ts_utc>=ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<ta.valid_to))) AS matched_plus_gapped

WITH base AS (
  SELECT st.settlement_id,
         st.settled_eur_minor,
         date(st.settled_at) AS sdate,
         ROUND((CAST(t.amount_minor AS REAL) / POW(10, c.exponent)) * f.eur_per_unit * 100) AS recomp
  FROM settlement st
  JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id = st.txn_id
  JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id = t.currency_id
  JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id = t.currency_id AND f.rate_date = date(st.settled_at)
), wk AS (
  SELECT *,
         date(sdate, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', sdate) AS INT) + 6) % 7) || ' days') AS monday,
         CAST((julianday(date(sdate, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', sdate) AS INT) + 6) % 7) || ' days')) - julianday('2024-12-30')) / 7 AS INT) + 1 AS weeknum
  FROM base
)
SELECT strftime('%Y', monday) || '-W' || printf('%02d', weeknum) AS iso_week,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(ABS(recomp - settled_eur_minor)) AS diff_cents
FROM wk
GROUP BY monday
ORDER BY diff_cents DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH leaf AS (
  SELECT g.group_id, g.name
  FROM dim_merchant_group g
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_merchant_group c WHERE c.parent_group_id = g.group_id)
),
t AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc, m.merchant_group_id AS gid,
    CASE WHEN t.ts_utc < '2025-07-01 00:00:00' THEN 'h1' ELSE 'h2' END AS half
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_merchant_link l
    ON l.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
   AND l.start_ts <= t.ts_utc
   AND (l.end_ts IS NULL OR l.end_ts > t.ts_utc)
  JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id = l.merchant_id
)
SELECT lf.name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN half='h1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h1,
  SUM(CASE WHEN half='h2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN half='h1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN half='h2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss
FROM leaf lf
LEFT JOIN t ON t.gid = lf.group_id
GROUP BY lf.group_id, lf.name
ORDER BY loss DESC

WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
  SELECT 10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.group_id FROM dim_merchant_group g JOIN sub ON g.parent_group_id = sub.id
),
merchants AS (
  SELECT merchant_id FROM dim_merchant WHERE group_id IN (SELECT id FROM sub)
),
s1 AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id, date(t.ts_utc) AS d
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
    AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from
    AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
  WHERE ta.merchant_id IN (SELECT merchant_id FROM merchants)
    AND t.ts_utc >= '2025-01-01' AND t.ts_utc < '2026-01-01'
),
s2 AS (
  SELECT d,
    (strftime('%w', d) + 6) % 7 AS wd0
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d FROM s1)
),
s3 AS (
  SELECT d,
    date(d, printf('-%d days', wd0), '+3 days') AS thursday,
    strftime('%Y', date(d, printf('-%d days', wd0), '+3 days')) AS isoyear
  FROM s2
),
s4 AS (
  SELECT d, thursday, isoyear,
    date(isoyear || '-01-04', printf('-%d days', (strftime('%w', isoyear || '-01-04') + 6) % 7)) AS monday_w1
  FROM s3
)
SELECT isoyear || '-W' || printf('%02d', CAST((julianday(thursday) - julianday(monday_w1)) / 7 AS INTEGER) + 1) AS iso_week,
  COUNT(*) AS txns
FROM s4 JOIN s1 USING(d)
GROUP BY iso_week
ORDER BY txns DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Cross-check: verify date ranges per top week and totals
WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT g.group_id FROM dim_merchant_group g JOIN sub ON g.parent_group_id = sub.id),
merchants AS (SELECT merchant_id FROM dim_merchant WHERE group_id IN (SELECT id FROM sub)),
s1 AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id, date(t.ts_utc) AS d
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
    AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
  WHERE ta.merchant_id IN (SELECT merchant_id FROM merchants)
    AND t.ts_utc >= '2025-01-01' AND t.ts_utc < '2026-01-01'
),
iso AS (
  SELECT s1.d,
    (strftime('%w', s1.d) + 6) % 7 AS wd0
  FROM s1
),
th AS (
  SELECT d,
    date(d, printf('-%d days', wd0), '+3 days') AS thursday,
    strftime('%Y', date(d, printf('-%d days', wd0), '+3 days')) AS isoyear
  FROM iso
),
wk AS (
  SELECT d, isoyear,
    isoyear || '-W' || printf('%02d', CAST((julianday(thursday) - julianday(date(isoyear || '-01-04', printf('-%d days', (strftime('%w', isoyear || '-01-04') + 6) % 7)))) / 7 AS INTEGER) + 1) AS iso_week
  FROM th
)
SELECT iso_week, MIN(d) AS first_day, MAX(d) AS last_day, COUNT(DISTINCT d) AS n_days, COUNT(*) AS txns
FROM wk JOIN s1 USING(d)
GROUP BY iso_week
HAVING txns > 2900
ORDER BY txns DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE weeks(w) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT w+1 FROM weeks WHERE w<52),
divs AS (
  SELECT group_id AS div_id, name FROM dim_merchant_group
  WHERE parent_group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE parent_group_id IS NULL)
),
sub AS (
  SELECT d.div_id, g.group_id AS sub_id
  FROM divs d JOIN dim_merchant_group g ON g.group_id=d.div_id OR g.parent_group_id=d.div_id
),
counts AS (
  SELECT s.div_id,
    CAST((julianday(substr(t.ts_utc,1,10)) - julianday('2024-12-30'))/7 AS INTEGER)+1 AS w,
    COUNT(*) AS y
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id=t.terminal_id
    AND t.ts_utc>=ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc<ta.valid_to)
  JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id=ta.merchant_id
  JOIN sub s ON s.sub_id=m.group_id
  WHERE substr(t.ts_utc,1,4)='2025'
  GROUP BY s.div_id, w
)
SELECT d.name,
  SUM(c.y) AS total,
  (52*SUM(c.w*c.y) - 1378*SUM(c.y)) / 609076.0 AS slope
FROM divs d
JOIN counts c ON c.div_id=d.div_id AND c.w BETWEEN 1 AND 52
GROUP BY d.div_id
ORDER BY slope DESC

WITH timeouts AS (
  SELECT s.txn_id, s.ts_utc, s.terminal_id
  FROM txn s
  JOIN response_code_dict r
    ON r.code = s.response_code
   AND r.is_timeout = 1
   AND r.valid_from <= s.ts_utc
   AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > s.ts_utc)
  WHERE s.ts_utc >= '2025-09-18 00:00:00'
    AND s.ts_utc < '2025-09-19 00:00:00'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS retried_any_later_txn_same_terminal
FROM timeouts s
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM txn n
  WHERE n.terminal_id = s.terminal_id
    AND n.txn_id <> s.txn_id
    AND (strftime('%s', n.ts_utc) - strftime('%s', s.ts_utc)) > 0
    AND (strftime('%s', n.ts_utc) - strftime('%s', s.ts_utc)) <= 90
)

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.settled_eur_minor,
         t.amount_minor,
         c.exponent,
         f.eur_per_unit,
         date(s.settled_at) AS d,
         (CAST(strftime('%w', date(s.settled_at)) AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7 + 1 AS isodow
  FROM settlement s
  JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id = s.txn_id
  JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id = t.currency_id
  JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id = t.currency_id AND f.rate_date = date(s.settled_at)
), wk AS (
  SELECT base.*,
         date(d, (4 - isodow) || ' days') AS thu
  FROM base
), grp AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y', thu) AS iso_year,
         printf('%02d', (CAST(strftime('%j', thu) AS INTEGER) - 1)/7 + 1) AS iso_week,
         SUM(ABS(ROUND(CASE exponent WHEN 0 THEN amount_minor*1.0
                                     WHEN 2 THEN amount_minor/100.0
                                     WHEN 3 THEN amount_minor/1000.0 END * eur_per_unit * 100)
                - settled_eur_minor)) AS total_diff,
         COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM wk
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT iso_year || '-W' || iso_week AS week, total_diff, n
FROM grp
ORDER BY total_diff DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH RECURSIVE g AS (
  SELECT group_id FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE name = 'Helios Grocery'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mg.group_id FROM dim_merchant_group mg JOIN g ON mg.parent_group_id = g.group_id
),
matched AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id, t.ts_utc
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta
    ON ta.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
   AND ta.valid_from <= t.ts_utc
   AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
  JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id = ta.merchant_id
  WHERE m.group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM g)
),
wk AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN thu_jd IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE printf('%04d-W%02d',
        CAST(strftime('%Y', thu_jd) AS INTEGER),
        CAST((mon_jd - (julianday(printf('%04d-01-04', CAST(strftime('%Y', thu_jd) AS INTEGER)))
              - (((CAST(strftime('%w', julianday(printf('%04d-01-04', CAST(strftime('%Y', thu_jd) AS INTEGER)))) AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7))) ) / 7 + 1 AS INTEGER))
    END AS label
  FROM (
    SELECT julianday(date(ts_utc))
         + (4 - (((CAST(strftime('%w', date(ts_utc)) AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7) + 1)) AS thu_jd,
           julianday(date(ts_utc))
         + (4 - (((CAST(strftime('%w', date(ts_utc)) AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7) + 1)) - 3 AS mon_jd
    FROM matched
  )
)
SELECT label, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM wk
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY cnt DESC

WITH RECURSIVE g2 AS (
  SELECT group_id, name FROM dim_merchant_group WHERE level = 2
),
dsc(g, d) AS (
  SELECT group_id, group_id FROM g2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.g, mg.group_id FROM dsc d JOIN dim_merchant_group mg ON mg.parent_group_id = d.d
),
txn2025 AS (
  SELECT ta.merchant_id,
         strftime('%Y', date(t.ts_utc,'-3 days','weekday 4')) AS iy,
         CAST((julianday(date(t.ts_utc,'-3 days','weekday 4'))
              - julianday(date(strftime('%Y', date(t.ts_utc,'-3 days','weekday 4'))||'-01-01','-3 days','weekday 4')))/7 + 1 AS INTEGER) AS wk
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta
    ON ta.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
   AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from
   AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
  WHERE substr(t.ts_utc,1,4) = '2025'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT d.g AS gid, t.wk, COUNT(*) cnt
  FROM txn2025 t
  JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
  JOIN dsc d ON d.d = m.group_id
  WHERE t.iy = '2025' AND t.wk BETWEEN 1 AND 52
  GROUP BY d.g, t.wk
)
SELECT g2.name,
       SUM(cnt) AS total,
       ROUND((SUM(cnt*wk) - 26.5*SUM(cnt))/11713.0, 5) AS slope
FROM agg JOIN g2 ON g2.group_id = agg.gid
GROUP BY g2.group_id
ORDER BY slope DESC

WITH RECURSIVE dsc(d) AS (SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT mg.group_id FROM dsc JOIN dim_merchant_group mg ON mg.parent_group_id = dsc.d),
txn2025 AS (
  SELECT ta.merchant_id,
         strftime('%Y', date(t.ts_utc,'-3 days','weekday 4')) AS iy,
         CAST((julianday(date(t.ts_utc,'-3 days','weekday 4'))
              - julianday(date(strftime('%Y', date(t.ts_utc,'-3 days','weekday 4'))||'-01-01','-3 days','weekday 4')))/7 + 1 AS INTEGER) AS wk
  FROM txn t
  JOIN terminal_assignment ta ON ta.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
   AND t.ts_utc >= ta.valid_from AND (ta.valid_to IS NULL OR t.ts_utc < ta.valid_to)
  WHERE substr(t.ts_utc,1,4)='2025'
)
SELECT wk, COUNT(*) c FROM txn2025 t
JOIN dim_merchant m ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
JOIN dsc ON dsc.d = m.group_id
WHERE iy='2025'
GROUP BY wk ORDER BY wk

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.settlement_id, s.settled_at, s.settled_eur_minor,
         t.amount_minor, t.currency_id, c.exponent, date(s.settled_at) AS sd
  FROM settlement s
  JOIN txn t ON t.txn_id = s.txn_id
  JOIN dim_currency c ON c.currency_id = t.currency_id
),
j AS (
  SELECT b.*, f.eur_per_unit
  FROM base b
  JOIN fx_rate_daily f ON f.currency_id = b.currency_id AND f.rate_date = b.sd
),
calc AS (
  SELECT *,
    CAST(ROUND( (amount_minor * 1.0 / (CASE exponent WHEN 0 THEN 1.0 WHEN 2 THEN 100.0 ELSE 1000.0 END)) * eur_per_unit * 100 ) AS INTEGER) AS recomputed
  FROM j
),
wk AS (
  SELECT ABS(recomputed - settled_eur_minor) AS diff,
         julianday(settled_at) + (4 - (((CAST(strftime('%w',settled_at) AS INTEGER)+6)%7)+1)) AS thursday_jd
  FROM calc
),
wky AS (
  SELECT diff, thursday_jd,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', date(thursday_jd)) AS INTEGER) AS iso_year,
         julianday(CAST(strftime('%Y', date(thursday_jd)) AS INTEGER) || '-01-01') AS jan1_jd,
         (((CAST(strftime('%w', CAST(strftime('%Y', date(thursday_jd)) AS INTEGER) || '-01-01') AS INTEGER)+6)%7)+1) AS jan1_dow
  FROM wk
)
SELECT printf('%04d-W%02d', iso_year, CAST((thursday_jd - (jan1_jd + ((4 - jan1_dow + 7) % 7)))/7 + 1 AS INTEGER)) AS iso_week,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(diff) AS total_diff
FROM wky
GROUP BY iso_week
ORDER BY total_diff DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_pairs, COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) AS total_txn
FROM txn t
JOIN terminal_merchant_link l ON l.terminal_id = t.terminal_id
  AND t.ts_utc >= l.start_ts AND (l.end_ts IS NULL OR t.ts_utc <= l.end_ts)
